run_reciprocal_nns_dot: run bruteforce_reciprocal_nns on two feature matrices using dot product similarity to find mutual nearest neighbors
run_reciprocal_nns_l2: run bruteforce_reciprocal_nns on two tensors using L2 distance to find reciprocal nearest neighbors
run_reciprocal_nns_blocked: run bruteforce_reciprocal_nns with a block_size parameter to process large matrices in memory-efficient chunks
run_nn_ratio_topk: run bruteforce_nn_ratio to compute top-k nearest neighbors and similarity ratios between two feature sets
run_nn_ratio_l2: run bruteforce_nn_ratio with L2 distance to find nearest neighbors and their ratio scores for outlier detection
